content: प्राप्तिः {%f.%} .²1 Obtaining, acquisition gain, attainment, profit; द्रव्य˚, यशः˚, सुख˚ <ab>&c.</ab>; अप्राप्तस्यैव या प्राप्तिः सैव संयोग उच्यते <ls>Bhāṣā P.</ls> .²2 Reaching or attaining to. .²3 Arrival, coming to. .²4 Finding, meeting with. .²5 Range, reach. .²6 A guess, conjecture. .²7 Lot, share, portion. .²8 Fortune, luck. .²9 Rise, production. .²10 The power of obtaining anything (one of the eight Siddhis, <ab>q. v.</ab>). .²11 Union, collection (संहति). .²12 The result of actions done in a former life. .²13 Fate, destiny; पक्षिणां तदपि प्राप्त्या नादत्तमुपतिष्ठति <ls>Pt. 2. 127</ls>. .²14 Being valid, holding good, application (as of a rule). .²15 The successful termination of a plot (सुखागम). .²16 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) A conjecture based on the observation of a particular thing. .²17 (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of the 11th lunar mansion.
